summary: Every array position can change the required removal count and must be inspected; the accepted one-pass counting source meets this linear lower bound with constant storage.

optimality.argument: If any position is not inspected, its value can be changed between one below k and one at least k while preserving the guarantee that another value meets k, changing the answer by one. Counting qualifying removals once per element therefore achieves the necessary linear work.

replacement_checks.evidence: An unread value may lie on either side of k and changes the minimum operation count accordingly.
The reference performs one comparison and one conditional count contribution for each array value.
Authored cases cover zero removals, one remaining element, equality with k, maximum values, unsorted input, and the maximum length.
